<thought>To obtain the precursors for the target molecule using the Doebner modification template, we replace the α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid fragment (C=CC(=O)O) with the corresponding aldehyde (C=O) and add malonic acid (HOOC‑CH2‑COOH). The aromatic portion of the molecule remains unchanged. Thus the retrosynthetic step yields the aromatic aldehyde Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1 and malonic acid C(C(=O)O)C(=O)O. No other distinct combinations are generated by this template.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1\", \"C(C(=O)O)C(=O)O\"]]</final_answer>
